title: Chapter 661 - 661 Top Rank; So Noisy!
content:
Chapter 661 - 661 Top Rank; So Noisy!

Chapter 661 - 661 Top Rank; So Noisy!

661 Top Rank; So Noisy!

Countless discussions surged like a tide.

“Kaiser Jack? That demon? He’s still alive? Moreover, he’s ranked fifth in the world in terms of strength!”

“I can’t help but shiver when I recall the legend of Kaiser.”

“Not only is Kaiser still alive, but he’s also obtained even more powerful strength. This… What a terrifying disaster.”

“Don’t worry. Didn’t you see? Fu Xuantian, Hu Yixiao, Liu Qi, and Xue Zhan are all on the rankings. Liu Qi and Xue Zhan are ranked fourth and third respectively!”

“Liu Qi and Xue Zhan are only ranked fourth and third. Who do you think is ranked second and first?”

…

Under the anticipation of countless people, the golden light finally condensed into a few large words.

[Second place: Yu Feng.]

[Reward: 50 years of lifespan, 20% increase in special energy, and 100,000 points increase in physique.]

In an ancient room, Yu Feng sat cross-legged with a face full of wrinkles and white hair.

In the next moment…

Yu Feng suddenly opened his eyes. His eyes were like the scorching sun. His tyrannical aura was like a storm that instantly sent the entire room flying.

His white hair quickly turned black, and the wrinkles on his skin quickly disappeared.

Then, Yu Feng slowly looked up at the Strength Rankings under the night sky. A thoughtful expression appeared on his face.

…

At the headquarters of the Xia Alliance.

“I knew it. Teacher is definitely fine!” Hu Yixiao laughed.

“50 years of lifespan!” Liu Qi said excitedly. “Master has gained another 50 years of lifespan! That’s great!”

Xue Zhan did not speak, but the excitement on his face was no less than the two of them.

…

In fact, not only were the three of them excited, but countless people around the world were also extremely excited.

“Yu Feng? The previous Special Abilities Chief?”

“In this world, other than him, I believe there is no other expert called Yu Feng.”

“That’s great! I can finally see Yu Feng’s glory!”

“Every time I recall the scene of Yu Feng fighting ten mutated beasts alone, I can feel tears in my eyes!”

“The Yu Feng we miss is back!”

“Why? Why is Yu Feng only second? This doesn’t make sense!”

“That’s right! Yu Feng is the current War God. If he’s second, who would dare to be first?”

“Are you sure there’s no problem with the rankings?”

…

After Yu Feng’s name appeared, everyone was excited and focused more on the Strength Rankings.

Under everyone’s attention, the light of the Strength Rankings grew brighter and brighter.

Finally, it condensed into a few big words again.

[First place: Lin Fan]

[Reward: 100 years of lifespan, 200,000 points of strength, and any skill level increase.]

Seeing this…

The entire world exclaimed.

“Lin Fan?!”

“Lin Fan was also ranked first on the Wealth Rankings last time! Could they be the same person? But, who exactly is Lin Fan?”

“I’ve never heard of him before! He’s both the richest and strongest man in the world! What’s going on?”

“I now doubt the accuracy of the rankings.”

“Lin Fan? I’ve never heard of him before! Has anyone heard of him?”

“No, I haven’t.”

“Never heard of him.”

“I… I seem to have heard of him. A thousand years ago, the hero who represented Hua Nation to enter the Otherworld was called Lin Fan.”

As soon as this person said this, everyone suddenly stopped talking.

They were all stunned.

The Lin Fan from a thousand years ago!

If it was that great man, perhaps…

…

At the headquarters of the Xia Alliance.

Hu Yixiao frowned and asked, “Do you know who this Lin Fan is? Why haven’t I heard of him before?”

Liu Qi took out a stack of documents and said, “These are some of the results of my investigation after the appearance of the Wealth Rankings.”

Hu Yixiao took the document in confusion.

At first, he was still a little careless.

But soon, his eyes widened.

Hu Yixiao stammered, “Lin Fan is a shareholder of tens of thousands of companies? Among them, there are even the five major banks, the four major energy companies, and the four major technology companies… Is there a problem with this report?”

“What do you think?” Liu Qi asked.

“But… But… Aren’t some of these companies controlled by the Xia Alliance? How could there be so many shares in the hands of one individual?” Hu Yixiao was puzzled.

“The Xia Alliance?” Liu Qi sighed. “That would require the existence of the Xia Alliance.”

“The existence of the Xia Alliance? What do you mean?” Hu Yixiao was even more confused.

Liu Qi said, “According to our investigation, Lin Fan owned most of these shares before the Xia Alliance was established.”

“Before the establishment of the Xia Alliance?”

“Yes.” Liu Qi nodded. “A thousand years ago, Lin Fan already had shares.”

“What?!” Hu Yixiao’s pupils constricted as he said, “Could it be that he’s…”

Xue Zhan already knew the relevant information, so his expression remained the same.

“How’s the situation with the beast tide in Jiangbei?” he asked in a low voice. “Fu Xuantian should be arriving soon, right?”

…

At the edge of Jiangbei…

After all the names and rewards were announced, Qin Zhong slowly retracted his gaze.

He looked at the tense warriors and said in a clear voice, “The eighth-ranked commander, Elder Fu Xuantian, is already on his way!

“As long as we hold on, it’ll be a victory!”

The moment he said that, all the warriors with special abilities became solemn. They were extremely excited.

Firstly, it was because they knew Fu Xuantian’s strength and saw hope in defeating the beast tide.

Secondly, it was because they admired Fu Xuantian.

In a sense, they were fighting alongside Fu Xuantian by resisting the beast tide!

This honor that made them proud!

At this moment, the ground suddenly shook.

Everyone looked into the distance and saw countless exotic beasts rushing over like a flood.

They bared their fangs and brandished their claws as they roared toward the sky. The sound was deafening.

Even though the warriors with special abilities had extraordinary strength, their faces could not help but turn slightly pale.

Qin Zhong was also shocked by this scene.

However, he quickly reacted and shouted, “Everyone, prepare for battle!”

The super laser cannons hidden in the distance shot out beams of light like meteors.

The 100 super laser cannons were extremely powerful. If they were to face hundreds or even thousands of exotic beasts, they would have the ability to annihilate them.

However, at this moment, the laser cannons were not enough to face 100,000 of mutated beasts.

Smoke and dust flew everywhere as the beasts roared wildly, forming a powerful sound wave that shook the mountains. It was extremely terrifying.

Qin Zhong, Li Dahai, and the other warriors with special abilities were shocked. They gathered their courage and prepared for battle.

At this moment, a loud and clear voice suddenly sounded.

“It’s so noisy!”
